checks: All five bundled packages use product-facing descriptions while retaining their original license in details

Malformed advanced configuration is rejected locally without invoking the backend
Bundled extension removal and reinstall preserve explicit enablement while runtime errors never claim activation
Pet settings disclose backend limitations and expose only supported native sound choices
Legacy unsupported enhancements can be disabled while unsupported enabling stays blocked
All-market refresh includes both catalogs, source refresh is scoped, and tag search ignores surrounding spaces
A failed plugin list refresh retains visible installed entries and can recover without restarting
Market installation remains disabled until explicit enabling and preserves authorization and restart notices
Installed version, update and missing-package repair actions follow the backend contract
Delisted plugins remain manageable and uninstall failures stay visible without dismissing details
Connection validation stays in its modal and a new client version requires a new compatibility acknowledgement
Custom middleware validates JSON, displays backend save errors in the editor and starts disabled
Middleware separates enabled state from waiting, successful, failed and blocked execution with verification time

Workspace asset failure preserves the last list and the native-plugin card links to managed plugins
Remote mode exposes no desktop mutation controls or editable middleware scripts; no renderer exceptions
scope: Chromium UI with real bundled manifest schemas and controlled IPC responses; no real client injection or downloads
